scope: Read-only assessment of one unexecuted UI rejection/review branch; no global or native acceptance opinion.
question: Can the existing real HTTP/C08/SQLite fixture deterministically cause the first selection save to return 409 conflict/selection-not-committed using only transport ordering and a real concurrent mutation?
conclusion: No suitable deterministic seam exists in the admitted fixture for that exact response. The ordinary real storage-version race returns a different producer response. No test or product code was changed.

facts.detail: Durable prior receipt is resolved before the expected namespace-version check. A version mismatch returns conflict/product-state-changed, not preview.
preview is returned only after the real work callback returns commit:false and post-work authority/target checks remain valid.

The producer reads the current case, prepares source/current-case fences and executes a preferences transaction. It maps only preview to conflict/selection-not-committed (HTTP409); any other non-ok result, including product-state-changed, becomes unavailable/selection-unavailable (HTTP503).
Only the exact 409 conflict/selection-not-committed envelope is a known precommit conflict.
Explicit rejected-selection review re-reads authorized case and storage version before clearing rejected and generating a new key. It does not save.
Only a first, not-previously-uncertain known precommit conflict enters rejected; any previously uncertain mutation remains an exact retry.

realOrderingsAvailable.ordering: Hold the initial browser create request; commit another real selection through canonical HTTP; continue the held request unchanged.
realOrderingsAvailable.causalResult: preferences expectedStorageVersion is stale; C08 returns conflict/product-state-changed; the selection producer maps it to HTTP503 selection-unavailable. This cannot validate the known409 review branch.

realOrderingsAvailable.ordering: Hold the initial browser create request; commit a real case change; continue the held request unchanged.
realOrderingsAvailable.causalResult: The selection producer reads the newer case as its current case before constructing the stored identity. Existing fourth test covers successful acknowledgement with subsequent case-change warning; it is not the requested internal precommit409.

realOrderingsAvailable.ordering: Change case identity/storage state after the producer last verifies its case/fence but before its C08 work callback.
realOrderingsAvailable.causalResult: May return preview and then exact409 if authority remains valid. Existing fixture exposes no gate or observation for this internal window. Replacing or wrapping state/cases/fence to force the point would introduce a new producer seam; timing-only concurrent loops would be nondeterministic.

ownerRecommendation.owner: Collaboration producer / integration owner; foreign path is not edited by Astra interface.
ownerRecommendation.proposal: Consider translating C08 conflict/product-state-changed, as well as preview, to conflict/selection-not-committed. Review this in the producer and publish an exact blob before intake. Do not translate arbitrary unavailable/denied/idempotency or target failures.
ownerRecommendation.reason: C08 checks durable prior receipts before the version comparison, so the specific storage-version refusal is an observed precommit refusal. Our existing uncertain-retry branch still must not treat a later409 as a new intent.
ownerRecommendation.futureCounterproof: After owner publication, gate only browser transport, commit a second real canonical selection with current version and a distinct key, forward original unchanged, assert initial409/exact reason and no receipt/effect for rejected key, assert records/period locked and no retry/new POST until explicit review, reauthorize/read version, then explicitly save with new key/current version and assert one effect for the new intent in addition to the separately counted competing selection.

limits: No product, typecheck, guard, browser or CI execution was performed.
Static source analysis does not prove the unexecuted first-known409 UI branch.
Five existing real selection cases retain their prior W14 evidence; this assessment does not replace or rerun those observations.
No claim that case-bound work composition, native proofs or global gates are complete.
